sources.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: one historical game portrait photograph card. Image1 is the EXACT ORIGINAL card and the sole composition, clothing, lighting and layout authority. Image2 supplies ONLY the yellow mascot species/face identity; it is NOT a person to insert into the scene.
Edit the ORIGINAL card by converting ONLY the actual visible people, in their original seats or standing positions, to tiny golden-yellow mascot people INSIDE the same existing dark suits, white shirts and neckwear. Keep their head scale appropriate to this room-wide view. Retain any hair/brows/facial hair genuinely visible in Image1, without inventing unreadable crowd details. Green-ringed black eyes, compact yellow heads and very short broad neck transitions fitted naturally into the source collars; no long yellow neck, neck bib or new bare torso. Preserve the actual poses, directions, light and crop. Do not enlarge or feature any individual.
Lock the room and spatial anchors to Image1: the tall rounded arch and supporting columns, warm wooden balcony with rows of dark blue-green rear chairs, original lower chamber crowd, angled wooden benches/desks flanking the pale central aisle, and the foreground desk on the RIGHT with its source papers. The pale aisle must retain its original continuous depth and position from the lower foreground toward the rear standing group. The actual clothed standing figure near the BACK of the aisle remains clothed and at that rear location. Convert the heads/anatomy in place, leaving existing clothes, tables, seats, walls, lighting and empty floor in place. No extra freestanding mascot in the near/central aisle; do not copy the full-body reference pose. No transverse desk across the foreground aisle, new person, relocated bench, enlarged foreground body or replacement parliament arrangement.
Keep the exact tilted narrow photograph frame, full solid original photographic backing and the overlapping pale beige note on the right. The note continues to cover the same portion of the source picture. Preserve its TWO compact upper dark marking rows/groups as indistinct original visual strokes with the same placement, footprint and contrast; keep the rest of the paper blank. No new readable words, labels or writing. Maintain the original aspect ratio, card silhouette and painterly source lighting at full generated resolution. Genuine transparency only outside the complete original frame-and-note silhouette; the room, people, clothes, backing and note must remain solid. One asset, no comparison board or watermark.
